description.value: The Creston & District Community Complex is a publicly operated multi-sport recreation facility run by the Regional District of Central Kootenay, serving the Creston Valley. It hosts a broad range of activities including ice hockey, skating, curling, swimming, fitness, and pickleball under one roof. For a touring cyclist passing through the Kootenays, it represents a significant community hub with potential access to amenities typical of a full-service recreation complex.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The specific OSM URL returned a 404 'Page not found' on the RDCK website, so no amenity detail for the Creston complex could be confirmed from website content. The RDCK site navigation across multiple subpages consistently lists 'Creston & District Community Complex' as an active facility under Parks & Recreation, confirming the place is real and operated by the Regional District of Central Kootenay. OSM sport tags (swimming, fitness, ice hockey, curling, pickleball) characterize the facility type but cannot be used to infer specific amenities such as showers or washrooms without direct confirmation.
concerns: The specific OSM website URL (https://rdck.ca/EN/main/services/recreation/complexes-facilities/creston-complex-info.html) returns a 404 'Page not found' error; the URL likely needs to be updated to the current RDCK page for this facility.
No amenities could be confirmed from website content due to the 404; a manual check of the updated URL is recommended to fill in amenity fields.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible regional recreation complex actively listed in the RDCK's own navigation. The broken specific URL does not indicate closure.

wow_evidence: RDCK multi-sport complex (pool, rinks, curling, fitness, pickleball) — cluster parent for the aquatic centre, arena, and curling records; pool earns after-ride band.
blurb: Creston's recreation complex: pool, rinks, fitness, and pickleball under one roof.
